title: Cubic edge-transitive graphs of order $\ell p^2$
summary: A graph is edge-transitive if its automorphism group acts transitively on its edge set. This paper is devoted to a systematic study of cubic edge-transitive graphs of order $\ell p^2$, where $p$ is a prime and $\ell$ is an even integer. We first show that either $Γ$ is the unique cubic edge-transitive graph of order $18$, or its full automorphism group $\mathrm{Aut}(Γ)$ contains a normal Sylow $p$-subgroup $P$ which is isomorphic to either $Z_{p^2}$ or $Z_{p}^2$.
